items.html: Therefore, AA of Yetzirah has only the aspect of three included in three, which are NNH included in HGT, and only three Sefirot are discernible in him. And likewise Aba of Yetzirah — three within three — like AA. For also in Beriah they were both equal. However, Ima of Yetzirah, which had in Beriah a complete Partzuf. And likewise ZON of Yetzirah — they are all the aspect of VAK, for each one alone.
